textos.Lançado em 2003 e dirigido por Bong Joon: Released in 2003 and directed by Bong Joon-ho, Memories of Murder is a production that combines drama, crime and thriller, set in South Korea. The narrative follows the creation of a special police unit tasked with quickly investigating and solving an unprecedented series of brutal murders in a rural province.
textos.A experiência cinematográfica apoia-se e: The cinematic experience rests on a dark, oppressive atmosphere, driven by a deliberately measured pace throughout its running time. The dynamic moves between the seriousness of the criminal investigation and the behavioral frictions within the investigators' routine.
textos.De modo geral, os diferentes grupos aval: Overall, the different groups assess the same elements of the work, diverging on the verdict on how effective its execution is. Among the vast majority of ratings (~94%), a good portion stress the strength of the performances and the moral complexity of the detectives. A significant share values the composition of the cinematography and the creation of the tense mood, while a smaller slice considers that, despite the measured pace at the start, the rising tension sustains the running time.
